limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Conductances and wetting delays are chosen teaching parameters, not calibrated measurements.
No capillary transport, absorption, swelling, tearing, pressure deformation or edge-leakage solver.
Apparatus geometry and droplet markers are schematic; markers do not measure physical droplet sizes.
The guide stages four test intervals within its 100-second duration; the independent trial runs at 1× while visible.
